architectural_units.name: User
architectural_units.description: The user is the actor that accesses the portal and applications.

architectural_units.name: Administrator
architectural_units.description: The administrator is a user with additional permissions to manage application access.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: The presentation layer is responsible for displaying information to the user and capturing interactions.

architectural_units.name: Business Logic Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer applies the domain rules and processes the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Access Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer interacts with the database.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer
architectural_units.description: The domain layer defines the data model.

architectural_units.name: Contract Layer
architectural_units.description: A transversal layer that separates the internal model from the external API representation.

architectural_units.name: Leader
architectural_units.description: This microservice acts as a central point for traffic management and routing communications.

architectural_units.name: Portal
architectural_units.description: The portal microservice offers a centralized interface for accessing different VWGS applications.

architectural_units.name: Access Control
architectural_units.description: This microservice manages user authentication and permissions.

architectural_units.name: Communication Log
architectural_units.description: This microservice registers all communications within the system for traceability and auditing.

architectural_units.name: Scheduler
architectural_units.description: This microservice is responsible for the planning and programming of processes within the system.

architectural_units.name: View
architectural_units.description: The View component is responsible for the presentation of screens and capturing user interactions.

architectural_units.name: ViewModel
architectural_units.description: The ViewModel acts as an intermediary between the View and the Model, managing data processing and user actions.

architectural_units.name: Model
architectural_units.description: The Model defines the data contract consumed by the view and ViewModel.

architectural_units.name: Controller
architectural_units.description: Controllers process received requests, manage validation, and channel requests to the data layer.

architectural_units.name: Repository
architectural_units.description: Repositories are responsible for performing queries on the database.

architectural_units.name: Angular
architectural_units.description: Framework used for the frontend development.

architectural_units.name: Spring Boot
architectural_units.description: Framework used for the backend development.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol used for message exchange.

architectural_units.name: JSON
architectural_units.description: Data format used for message exchange.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Web Services
architectural_units.description: Cloud provider for the system.

architectural_units.name: Kubernetes
architectural_units.description: Container orchestration platform used for deployment.
The user accesses the portal and applications.
The Leader microservice routes all communications to the corresponding microservice within the system architecture.
The portal microservice incorporates the binaries necessary for the frontEnd of both the portal itself and the rest of the portal applications.
The View component is responsible for capturing user interactions, while the ViewModel acts as an intermediary between the View and the Model, managing data processing and user actions.
The services are responsible for orchestrating HTTP calls to the server.
Controllers process received requests, manage validation, and channel requests to the data layer.
The services call the corresponding functions to obtain the result of the request.
Repositories are responsible for performing queries on the database.

patterns.name: Microservices
patterns.description: Consisteix a dividir el sistema en un conjunt de serveis petits, independents i autònoms on cada microservei s’encarrega d’una funcionalitat específica i es comunica amb la resta mitjançant diversos sistemes de missatgeria.

patterns.name: Cloud Architecture
patterns.description: L’aplicació està dissenyada, desplegada i executada utilitzant serveis al núvol (cloud computing) en lloc de servidors locals o físics propis.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: L’aplicació segueix el patró Client-Servidor el qual organitza el codi en dos components diferenciats: el client, que formula sol·licituds de servei, i el servidor, que les rep, les processa i retorna respostes.

patterns.name: MVVM
patterns.description: Angular aplica el patró MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel), ja que la seva arquitectura està basada en components i serveis.

patterns.name: Layered Architecture
patterns.description: Spring Boot organitza el codi seguint el patró a capes amb les quals se separen responsabilitats: la capa de presentació rep les peticions i construeix les respostes, la capa de lògica de negoci aplica les regles del domini, la capa d’accés a dades interactua amb la base de dades i la capa de domini defineix el model de dades.
fixes: The document refers to this as 'patró a capes' (Layered Pattern/Architecture) within the server component.
